runs.question: What if we're sprinklered throughout?
runs.text:
If the building is **sprinklered throughout**, that satisfies one condition for the fire-damper exception—but it does **not** by itself remove the fire-damper requirement. For the one-hour corridor fire barrier, the exception also requires a non-Group H area and a ducted HVAC system made of at least 26-gage sheet metal, continuous from the HVAC equipment to the air terminals. If those conditions are met, a fire damper is not required there. [S1]

That exception addresses the **fire damper at the corridor wall only**. The separate smoke-barrier penetration may still require a smoke damper, subject to its own exceptions. [S4]

runs.question: What if we're sprinklered throughout?

That exception addresses the **fire damper only**. If this is a public corridor, a smoke damper may still be required; sprinklering throughout is not, by itself, an exception to that requirement. [S2] The separate smoke-barrier penetration also has its own smoke-damper rule and exceptions. [S4]
